source_case_note: Current production OpenFOAM-ECM reference case (chtMultiRegionSolidFoam, 2506). A second case, cases/wedge_2170_constant_heat_rtherm, shares identical geometry/materials but uses a finite base-contact resistance and a fixed volumetric heat source instead of ECM coupling; treated as a secondary/legacy sensitivity variant, NOT the primary reference (see unknowns).
coordinate_system: cylindrical, axis = global Z, origin (0,0,0), z=0 at can bottom outer face

JellyRoll.cp_model: hTabulated (piecewise-linear vs T), consistent with rho_ref/Cp_ref/Cp_grad in docs/WEDGE_2170_BATTERY_CELL_THERMAL_PROPERTIES_REFERENCE.md: Cp(T)=980+3*(T_degC-25) J/kgK

conductivity_tensor_W_per_mK.form: cylindrical (r,theta,z), transport=tabulatedAnIso, constant with T in this case (single triplet)

Can.shape: hollow cylinder (radial wall, r 0.01031368-0.010545) union solid bottom disc (r 0-0.010545, z 0-0.00023132); i.e. Can wraps the JellyRoll radially AND forms a thin bottom wall under it. No top wall (top is bounded by Cap domain).

Cap.shape: solid disc, full radius, no bottom-side equivalent domain exists in this reference model

interfaces.contact_resistance: none specified (no thicknessLayers/kappaLayers block) -> ideal/zero-resistance coupled contact

explicit thin-layer resistance: thicknessLayers=6.01519461276695e-07 m, kappaLayers=1 (dimensionless-scaled). This is nonzero but numerically small; NOT the same value as the 5.40067678 K/W 'Rtherm_jroll_base' documented in docs/WEDGE_2170_BATTERY_CELL_THERMAL_PROPERTIES_REFERENCE.md -- see unknowns.

heat_source.selectionMode: all (uniform application across every cell in jellyRoll_rotated)
heat_source.field: h (enthalpy equation source), volumetric field name ecmQdot
heat_source.coupling: functions/ecmCoupling (type ecmCoupler), region jellyRoll_rotated, zone jellyRoll_rotated, couplingMode lumped, lumpedOutput totalPower, totalVolumeScale 1 (full 360 deg cylinder, mesh is a wedge slice)
heat_source.external_process: python3 python/ecm_coupling_wrapper.py --backend ecm-step, driven by constant/electrical_inputs_from_validation.csv (time, current_A), persistent-pipe JSON IPC (ecm/ecm_in.json, ecm/ecm_out.json)
heat_source.zoning: single lumped zone = entire jellyRoll_rotated region; NOT split into axial or radial sub-zones
heat_source.reversible_entropic_heat_included: unknown -- not visible from OpenFOAM-side files; internal to ecm_coupling_wrapper.py / ecm-step backend, not audited in this run (out of scope: Python ECM backend internals)
heat_source.documented_vs_implemented_conflict: docs/WEDGE_2170_BATTERY_CELL_THERMAL_PROPERTIES_REFERENCE.md documents f_jroll=0.966, f_cap=0.034, f_can=0 (a three-way heat split). The actual committed OpenFOAM case (fvOptions only exists under jellyRoll_rotated; no fvOptions file exists under shell_rotated or cap_rotated) deposits 100% of ECM heat into jellyRoll_rotated and 0% into Can or Cap. This is an unresolved discrepancy between documentation and the executable reference model -- flagged, not resolved, per instructions not to invent values.

unknowns: f_cap/f_jroll/f_can heat-split fractions documented in docs/WEDGE_2170_BATTERY_CELL_THERMAL_PROPERTIES_REFERENCE.md do not match the actual fvOptions wiring in cases/wedge_2170 (100% into JellyRoll only). Not resolved here.

Rtherm_jroll_base = 5.40067678 K/W documented value does not reconcile with the thicknessLayers/kappaLayers (6.015e-7 m / 1) value on the jellyRoll<->shell 'bottom' patch in the current production case cases/wedge_2170 under a simple R=thickness/(kappa*area) full-360 check (~1.8e-3 K/W obtained, not 5.4 K/W). A separate variant case cases/wedge_2170_constant_heat_rtherm uses thicknessLayers=1.804785e-3 m on the same patch (implying R~1.8 K/W by the same check), closer in order of magnitude but still not an exact match. Reconciliation requires the original derivation of the 5.4 K/W figure, not available in-repo.
Whether reversible/entropic heat is included in the ECM heat deposited via ecmQdot is internal to the Python ecm-step backend and was not audited (out of scope of the OpenFOAM-side file inventory).

Existing postProcessing/jellyRoll_rotated/jellyRollMeanT time-history data found under both cases/wedge_2170 and cases/wedge_2170_constant_heat_rtherm are byte-identical despite the two cases having different fvOptions/contact-resistance configurations. This indicates at least one of the two result sets is stale/copied rather than freshly generated from its own case configuration. Neither is treated as validated transient evidence in this report; see docs/equivalence/STAR_CLIENT_EQUIVALENCE_TEST_PLAN.md Phase 6 note.
